decisions.reason: Four years on there is no sign of traction for this peripheral consumer drink mix, so its option value has largely gone and the resources are better spent on the core waste-to-energy ventures.
The modular extensions build on the established plant offer and cost little to keep listed, so the option stays open despite limited visible evidence of its value.
As a flagship drawing on core capabilities with long, project-based sales cycles, the waste oil plant still holds unresolved upside that justifies keeping it.
Plastic-to-fuel remains a strategically relevant flagship with high but uncertain upside, though the lack of visible results since 2019 raises the risk that it will be abandoned.
